title: Canonical point restriction coordinates and coefficient sections
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and its fixed uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The scheme universe $t$ and coefficient universe $u$ are independent; all scalar rings and modules are lifted to universe $\max(u,t+1)$. For $a\in\operatorname{Option}(\mathbf N)$, set $\Lambda_a=R$ for $a=\mathrm{none}$ and $\Lambda_a=R/(\varpi^{n+1})$ for $a=\mathrm{some}(n)$. Let $B_{S,a}$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf in the first case and the finite constant coefficient sheaf in the second [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For each site object $W$, define $\lambda_{a,W}:\Lambda_a\to B_{S,a}(W)$ by the constant-section map, followed in the integral case by the canonical map to the completion. For a scheme automorphism $g:S\to S$, use the canonical coefficient isomorphism $c_{g,a}:g^{-1}B_{S,a}\to B_{S,a}$ [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Define $G_{g,a}$ on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by the sectionwise inverse-image model, $(G_{g,a}M)(W\xrightarrow w S)=M(W\xrightarrow{gw}S)$, with action transported through $c_{g,a}^{-1}$ [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. Put $U=(S\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}S)$ and $V=(S\xrightarrow g S)$, and define $\alpha_g:V\to U$ to have underlying scheme map $g$. Define the additive map $\sigma^{\mathrm{raw}}_{g,a,M}:M(U)\to(G_{g,a}M)(U)$ to be the presheaf restriction $M(\alpha_g)$, using the sectionwise identification of the target with $M(V)$. When $S=\operatorname{Spec}k$ for any field $k$ of universe $t$, define $\Gamma_a$ to be evaluation at $U$ followed by restriction of scalars along $\lambda_{a,U}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], with its induced action on morphisms and additive-functor structure. Equip $\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_a)$ with its standard unbounded derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. These are coordinate constructions only; no linearity or naturality assertion for $\sigma^{\mathrm{raw}}$ is included, and no finite-field, algebraic-closure, invertibility-of-$\ell$, boundedness, constructibility or completeness hypothesis is imposed.
